title: Quantum Sphaera Companion: A Structure-First Mathematical Unfolding — full Companion and physics paper
description:
Quantum Sphaera Companion v5.3.0 is a minor version of the database-backed v5 release. As before, it comprises two complementary English documents from one source snapshot: the full Companion with its research history, and the physics paper Graded carriers and physical readouts: conditions for mass and geometric interpretation.

New in the full Companion are the research layers v4.10.0-r29 and r30. They record the counting rule of the matter frame as one number in several equivalent forms (flux lines of an isolated horizon, readout frequency, a Moran-equation reading, two readings of the frame register); a literature check that a unitary boost leaves the area spectrum unchanged, so that a frame-dependent area quantum would need a non-unitary frame map; the finding that the rule of the second frame has no data-free reason; a chance estimate under which the hits of the frame factor are compatible with chance once the choice of the counting-rule pair is counted; a map showing that the values in the other open problems go back to one number through five separately chosen translations, and a profile of a mediator that none of the recorded candidates meets; and five pre-registered, not blind tests on the bent octant. It also records explorations of the vacuum problem and a comparison of the tape machine in two hardware descriptions with the database calculus.

New in the physics paper: two development sections. The first shows that the sign of the octant step is not fixed: magnitudes and endpoints of the loop through three states fix its size, the reverse loop gives the conjugate phase, the compensator annihilates the closed odd states, and a selection of the ordered return is needed in addition. The second states that the conditional values rest on one number entering through separate identifications, most chosen after the data, and that a frame-dependent area quantum would require a non-unitary frame map.

Scope: this is a conditional mathematical-physics research programme, not a completed unified theory. No native lepton spectrum, absolute physical mass scale, general gravitational field equations or closure of the open problems is established by this release. The Koide overlap, the core size, the orientation of the octant step and the counting rule per frame remain open. Database registration, hashes and provenance checks do not constitute proof of physical interpretation. The manuscript has undergone documented self-review, not independent peer review.

The package contains two English PDFs, compilable sources, a database snapshot and checksum manifests. Both document editions retain open argument-review obligations.

Version DOI: pending reservation. Concept DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.19210728.
notes: Two complementary English documents in one versioned Companion record. The version DOI identifies the whole package. The German reader edition is excluded. Scientific guards and incomplete argument-review flags remain unchanged. Reservation and upload do not constitute publication.
